intro: Each board brings colour, type and drawn details together on everyday items.
Say in the chat what you would keep or change, such as the colours of 1 with the type of 3.
footnote: Monograms are placeholders, not logos. The real mark is drawn after a board is locked. The supplied mark stays in place.
